_comment: Static team metadata for the Agents HQ app, in the office's fixed order (clockwise from the top). The server (hq/server.py) serves it at /api/teams and recomputes each tool's status: 'connected' when a server named like one of its mcp aliases is in .mcp.json, or when its skill script exists.
